address: 2F, LN Garden Hotel, 368 Huanshi East Road, Yuexiu, Guangzhou, China Mainland
bio: Well-honed European techniques are put to use in the display kitchen to turn the best ingredients from around the world into creative, contemporary works of art. There is just one eight-course tasting menu and it changes bi-monthly, with a best of menu at the end of each year. Two wine pairing options are available at different price points. The wine list is well curated and the knowledgeable sommelier has some great tips for you....
